proposal: Proposed curated record for data/global/sources/farms_attachment.json (notable: often called the world's first wind farm): {"name": "Crotched Mountain", "iso": "USA", "lat": 42.998, "lon": -71.874, "mw": 0.6, "year": 1980, "type": "onshore", "turbine": "20 x US Windpower 30 kW", "owner": "US Windpower", "end": 1982, "status": "retired", "src": "curated", "url": "https://www.umass.edu/windenergy/about/history/alumni/index.html", "note": ["US Windpower 1980 年 12 月在新罕布夏州 Crotched Mountain 山肩裝設 20 部 30 kW 風機（麻州大學風能中心稱為世界第一座風場）；只運轉一、兩年就拆除，除役年 1982 為約略值（1982 年 1 月報導仍在運轉）。座標是山頂（風場在山的北側／西北稜線），為概略位置。", "US Windpower installed twenty 30 kW turbines on the shoulder of Crotched Mountain, New Hampshire, in December 1980 (called the world's first wind farm by the UMass Wind Energy Center); it lasted only a year or two before the turbines were taken apart, so the 1982 end year is approximate (a January 1982 report still describes it running). The point is the summit (the farm stood on the north / north-west ridge), an approximate position."]}; then FARMS "WIND-001": ["Crotched Mountain"]
note_zh: 不在風場層。麻州大學風能中心：US Windpower 1980 年 12 月在 Crotched Mountain 山肩裝了 20 部 30 kW 風機（0.6 MW）；Concord Monitor（2016）：風場在山的北側、只維持一、兩年就拆除；Christian Science Monitor 1982-01-27 仍描述它在運轉，所以除役約在 1982 年（約略值，來源沒有確切年份）。座標用維基百科的山頂（北緯 42.998°、西經 71.874°），風場在北側／西北稜線，屬概略位置。
note_en: Not in the layer. UMass Wind Energy Center: in December 1980 US Windpower installed twenty 30 kW turbines (0.6 MW) on the shoulder of Crotched Mountain; Concord Monitor (2016): it stood on the north side of the mountain and lasted only a year or two; the Christian Science Monitor still described it running on 27 Jan 1982, so it ended about 1982 (approximate; no source gives the exact year). The point is the summit from Wikipedia (42.998 N, 71.874 W); the farm was on the north / north-west ridge, so the position is approximate.
why: Sources disagree on the town (Greenfield vs Francestown) and the start (UMass: Dec 1980; CSM: "went into action last spring", i.e. 1981; Concord Monitor: dedicated April 1981, about four months after it started). No source gives the removal year; 1982 is the earliest year consistent with both the Jan 1982 CSM report and "a year or two". If an exact end year is required for a retired record, the main session may prefer to leave it out (a curated record with status retired but no end year is built as operating).

item: WIND-008 Kunimidake wind farm, Fukui (2013-12 fire)
farm: Kunimidake wind farm (original 1.8 MW farm, not in the layer)
proposal: (no FARMS entry, no new record) The 2013 fire was at the original 国見岳風力発電所 (2 x NEG Micon 900 kW = 1.8 MW, built Dec 2002 by Fukui Prefecture, Hokuriku Electric from Apr 2010). The layer's "Fukui Kunimidake wind farm" (37.8 MW, 2027, announced) is a later project, not this farm; no other record lies within 15 km. Too small to add as a notable record.
note_zh: 火災發生在原本的國見岳風力發電所（福井市奧平町，900 kW×2 部＝1,800 kW，NEG Micon，2002 年 12 月由福井縣興建，2010-04-01 由北陸電力受讓；北陸電力 2013-12-26 中間報告）。風場層只有 2027 年的新計畫「Fukui Kunimidake wind farm」（37.8 MW，宣布階段），不是同一座；半徑 15 km 內沒有其他紀錄。1.8 MW 規模小，不新增紀錄，事件維持不對應。
note_en: The fire was at the original Kunimidake wind farm (Okudaira, Fukui City; 2 x 900 kW = 1,800 kW, NEG Micon, built in Dec 2002 by Fukui Prefecture, taken over by Hokuriku Electric on 1 Apr 2010; Hokuriku Electric interim report of 26 Dec 2013). The layer only has the later 2027 project "Fukui Kunimidake wind farm" (37.8 MW, announced), a different farm; no other record lies within 15 km. At 1.8 MW it is too small for a new record, so the event stays unlinked.
why: Whether the two 900 kW units were repaired or removed after 2013 was not checked (the METI notice and the interim report do not say).

note_en: WorkSafe only says Rokewood; AAP and RenewEconomy name the Golden Plains Wind Farm at Rokewood (Vestas installation; a 36-year-old subcontractor crushed by a blade waiting on the ground to be lifted). The site was on Bells Road, off the Rokewood–Shelford Road east of Rokewood (Stock & Land); Bells Road (OSM way 205318904) is 0.25–0.66 km from the stage 1 (East, 122 turbines) positions in the site's turbines_osm.json, and after the accident Vestas paused construction on the first 756 MW stage. Stage 2 (West; the site's GEM record "Golden Plains wind farm (Australia)", 574 MW) only began construction in mid-2024. Linked to stage 1.
why: No source states the stage in so many words: the stage rests on the Bells Road location inside the stage 1 turbine array (an internal check against turbines_osm.json; the OSM API XML cannot be quoted by check_quotes) and on Vestas pausing stage 1 work. If the main session wants only explicitly stated links, use both records ["Golden Plains (Stage 1)", "Golden Plains wind farm (Australia)"] or leave it unlinked.

item: WIND-085 Huaneng Wenchang repowering, Typhoon Yagi (2024-09-06)
farm: Hainan Wenchang Chaotanbi wind farm · RP
note_zh: 界面新聞：倒塔的是華能海南發電的華能文昌風電廠「以大代小」改造升級項目（擬新建 16 台 6.25 MW 抗颱型風機、已吊裝 13 台，尚未併網）。湖南火電（施工方）2024-07：華能文昌風電廠「以大代小」增容改造項目位於文昌市錦山鎮東北部沿海，原裝機 52.5 MW、2008-12-21 全容量併網，拆除 32 台舊機、新建 16 台 6.25 MW，總容量增至 104 MW。本站 GEM 紀錄「Hainan Wenchang Chaotanbi wind farm · RP」（海南文昌風电厂“以大代小”增容改造项目，104 MW，興建中，錦山）就是這個改造案（GEM 同頁一期的營運者是華能海南發電）。
note_en: Jiemian: the collapsed towers belong to Huaneng Hainan Power's Wenchang wind farm "replace small with large" repowering (16 new 6.25 MW typhoon-class turbines planned, 13 erected, not yet connected). Hunan Thermal Power (the contractor), July 2024: the Huaneng Wenchang repowering is on the coast north-east of Jinshan town, Wenchang; the old farm (52.5 MW, fully connected on 21 Dec 2008) loses 32 old units and gains 16 x 6.25 MW, 104 MW in all. The site's GEM record "Hainan Wenchang Chaotanbi wind farm · RP" (104 MW, under construction, Jinshan) is this repowering (GEM's page names Huaneng Hainan Power as the phase 1 operator).
why: Name, owner, place (Jinshan, Wenchang) and capacity (104 MW) match. Side note for the record (not proposed here): the contractor gives hub 113 m and rotor 190 m for the new units.

item: Part 2a. Longyuan Rudong Intertidal Demo: unit list and capacity
proposal: fix('CHN', 'Longyuan Rudong Intertidal Demo', C, '2010 年 9 月投產時是 16 部試驗機組、32 MW（1.5–3 MW）；龍源 2019 與 2024 年運維招標列出現存 15 部、8 種機型：遠景 EN82/1.5、聯合動力 UP82-1500、海裝 H93-2000、明陽 MY1.5S、三一 SE93/2000、華銳 SL3000、上海電氣 W2000 各 2 部，金風 GW100/2500 1 部（招標寫總容量 27.5 MW，但所列機組合計 29.5 MW）。第 16 部（2.5 MW）何時、為何不在清單上待查；容量維持建成時的 32 MW', 'In service from Sept 2010 with 16 test units, 32 MW (1.5–3 MW); Longyuan’s O&M tenders of 2019 and 2024 list the 15 units still there, 8 models: 2 each of Envision EN82/1.5, Guodian United Power UP82-1500, CSSC Haizhuang H93-2000, Mingyang MY1.5S, Sany SE93/2000, Sinovel SL3000 and Shanghai Electric W2000, and 1 Goldwind GW100/2500 (the tenders state 27.5 MW, but the listed units add up to 29.5 MW). When and why the 16th unit (2.5 MW) left is still to be checked; the capacity stays at the as-built 32 MW', 'http://www.chnenergybidding.com.cn/bidweb/001/001002/001002003/20190814/91f278b0-cb76-4c62-81f7-9f3d77c5c03f.html', turbine='16 test units, 1.5–3 MW; 15 listed since 2019: 2x Envision EN82-1.5, 2x Guodian UP82-1.5, 2x CSSC Haizhuang H93-2.0, 1x Goldwind GW100-2.5, 2x Mingyang MY1.5S, 2x Sany SE93-2.0, 2x Sinovel SL3000, 2x Shanghai Electric W2000', note=True)
note_zh: 建成時：16 部、32 MW（geoseu 引述；前瞻網「3.2 萬千瓦試驗風電場 2010 年 9 月投產」為先前輪次已用的口徑）。2019-08 與 2024-07 兩份運維招標逐一列出現存機組：15 部、8 種機型，其中金風 GW100/2500 只有 1 部、其餘各 2 部；兩份都寫「總容量 27.5 MW」，但 2×1.5＋2×1.5＋2×2＋2.5＋2×1.5＋2×2＋2×3＋2×2＝29.5 MW，與招標自己的數字不符，應以機組清單為準。32 − 29.5 = 2.5 MW，推測少掉的是一部 2.5 MW（可能是第二部金風；建成時若是 8 家各 2 部正好 32 MW，但 geoseu 寫 9 家廠商，所以不能確定）。容量建議維持 32 MW（2010 年建成值），機型欄改列 2019 年清單；第 16 部何時離場待查（不知道年份，不改容量）。
note_en: As built: 16 units, 32 MW (geoseu). The O&M tenders of Aug 2019 and Jul 2024 list the remaining units one by one: 15 units of 8 models, Goldwind GW100/2500 x1 and the others x2. Both state "27.5 MW in total", but 2x1.5 + 2x1.5 + 2x2 + 2.5 + 2x1.5 + 2x2 + 2x3 + 2x2 = 29.5 MW, so the tenders' own total is wrong and the unit list is used. 32 − 29.5 = 2.5 MW: the missing unit was presumably a 2.5 MW machine (possibly a second Goldwind; 8 makers x 2 units would give exactly 32 MW, but geoseu says 9 makers, so this is not certain). Keep 32 MW (as built in 2010) and list the 2019 units in the turbine field; when the 16th unit left is unknown, so the capacity is not reduced.
why: No source lists the original 16 units or says when one left (CHN Energy full-text search: only the 2019 and 2024 O&M tenders list units; a 2026 Longyuan tender confirms the Huangang complex = 30 MW test + 50 MW expansion, 150 MW demo + 50 MW addition and the 200 MW expansion, 155 turbines). Alternative if the main session prefers current capacity: mw=29.5 with the same note, but that would under-count 2010 to the unknown removal year.

item: Part 2b. CTG Yangjiang Shapa phase 2: per-model counts
proposal: (lead) If the main session accepts a GlobalData profile backed by the CTG prospectus, edit the existing rule (farm_cleanup.py, 'CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 2', C) to turbine='31x Mingyang MySE6.45-180 + 31x Goldwind GW171-6.45' and add to its zh/en: '三峽能源招股書：二期風機及塔筒分兩個標段，I 標明陽智慧（14.996 億元）、II 標金風科技（14.646 億元）；GlobalData（Energy Monitor）列二期 I、II 各 31 台' / 'CTG New Energy prospectus: phase 2 turbines and towers were bought in two lots, lot I from Mingyang (CNY 1,499.6 m) and lot II from Goldwind (CNY 1,464.6 m); GlobalData (Energy Monitor) lists 31 units in each of phase 2-I and 2-II'.
note_zh: 仍是線索：(1) 陽江市自然資源局 2023-09 公示的補充論證報告書只寫 62 台、兩種機型（MySE6.45-180、GW171/6450），不分台數；同報告寫基礎全為導管架（非嵌岩 40、芯柱式嵌岩 13、植入式嵌岩 9），與現有 F5 一致。(2) 三峽能源 IPO 招股書（中國證券報 2021-04-26 摘要）重大合同：沙扒二期「風機及配套塔筒設備（I 標段）」明陽智慧 149,962.50 萬元、「（II 標段）」金風科技 146,463.38 萬元，兩標金額幾乎相同，符合各半（31＋31）。(3) GlobalData 的電廠資料（Energy Monitor）寫二期 I（明陽）31 台、二期 II（金風）31 台。前兩者是官方文件但沒有台數；只有 GlobalData 有台數，屬商業資料庫轉述，所以列線索。
note_en: Still a lead: (1) the supplementary sea-use report (Yangjiang natural resources bureau, Sept 2023) gives 62 units of two models (MySE6.45-180, GW171/6450) without a split; it also gives all-jacket foundations (40 non-rock-socketed, 13 core-pile rock-socketed, 9 implanted rock-socketed), consistent with the existing F5 row. (2) CTG New Energy's IPO prospectus (summary in China Securities Journal, 26 Apr 2021) lists the material contracts: phase 2 "turbines and towers (lot I)" Mingyang CNY 1,499.625 m and "(lot II)" Goldwind CNY 1,464.634 m, almost equal values, consistent with an even split (31 + 31). (3) GlobalData's plant profiles (Energy Monitor) give phase 2-I (Mingyang) 31 units and phase 2-II (Goldwind) 31 units. The official documents give no counts; only GlobalData does, a commercial database, so this stays a lead.
why: Not found: MSA notices or O&M tenders naming the split (CTG's eps.ctg.com.cn blocked in earlier rounds); Mingyang's own 2019 award notice for phase 2 (only mentioned in a 2020 report, without count); news sites ycwb.com (empty page) and thepaper.cn (short shell).
